name: Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA)
definition: A higher-level measure evaluating the relational structure (geometry of the manifold) induced over an entire set of views, complementing pointwise similarity. It assesses if the reconstructed latent space captures the same representational organization as the ground-truth.
summary: Representational Similarity Analysis evaluates latent space quality by comparing the relational structure of two representation sets, distinguishing itself from pointwise measures by assessing pairwise similarity preservation across entire view sets.
